name: Quick Help Card
description: Collapsible usage-help card at the top of the chat area with headerActions, body and footerActions semantic slots.

intents: show a quick help card at the chat top
在聊天区域顶部显示帮助卡片
add action buttons at the bottom of the help card
在帮助卡片底部加一排操作按钮

headerActions.description: Optional actions displayed in the help card header.

body.description: Help content displayed when the card is expanded.

footerActions.description: Optional action buttons rendered as one row at the bottom of the card, below the help content.
